domain: The gradual replacement of paper municipal records with digital archives, and whether there is a point at which a town's memory of itself stops being a record and becomes a reconstruction
topic: The gradual replacement of paper municipal records with digital archives, and whether there is a point at which a town's memory of itself stops being a record and becomes a reconstruction

movement.gist: Describe a small town clerk's office moving records to digital scans over decades — each year a small, defensible percentage of paper originals discarded after microfilming, then digitization, each step justified by cost and space, framed as pure continuum of improvement.

Concede that no single digitization decision was reckless — every migration preserved 'the same information' by the clerk's own accounting — and inside this concession plant the real thesis: granted that each transfer was locally faithful, the town's records office nonetheless became something categorically different from an archive.

Argue that somewhere in repeated migration (paper to microfilm to database to cloud), the record stopped being a trace of an event and became a representation optimized for retrieval — a kind-shift from memory-object to search-index, changing what 'consulting the town record' even means.

Probe for the exact migration that did it — was it the first microfilming, the first database entry, the first time a search query replaced a physical folder pull? Show each candidate threshold dissolving under scrutiny.

Conclude that the shift is real and irreversible but not locatable in any transfer event; the loss is structural to the practice of migration itself, not to any migration, and this non-locatability is itself the finding, not a failure to find it.

primary.axis: cumulative data loss vs. categorical loss of institutional memory
poles: archives suffer only incremental, quantifiable attrition
past some point the archive stops recording a town's past and starts inventing it
digitization relocates who gets to certify what counts as the record

tension_system.interaction: the secondary tension supplies the mechanism (loss of custodial certainty) that makes the primary threshold impossible to pin down even though its existence is granted

family_realization.note: Passage exhaustively executes threshold argument. Paragraph four's systematic negation ('not there...not there...not there...every candidate threshold...changed nothing') relocates the qualitative shift from any quantifiable transfer to the act of transferring itself. The finding IS the absence of a locatable threshold.

ending_behavior.note: Final paragraph affirms thesis ('is a real conclusion') while naming cost in same breath ('forbids the remedy it implies'). Aperture genuinely narrows: 'no migration to have refused, no year to have stopped at...monthly verified, and no longer of a kind that can be checked against anything but itself.' Refusal suspended.

voice_consistency.note: Spatial/flow metaphors ('extended without visible strain,' 'crossed each interval,' 'migrates,' 'position does not exist within the chain') dominate. Agents rarely grammatical subjects. But opening concreteness—'Ink pressed by a specific hand. A crease where it had been folded to fit a pocket. Coffee.'—anchors abstraction. Minor unevenness preserved.

distractor_efficiency.note: Q1(A): prior_belief trap—reads efficiency-narrative, ignoring baseline-shift clause. Q2(B): treats concession as softening when it's load-bearing. Q3(D): bit-integrity model tempts but misses categorical-shift argument. Q4(C): remedial hope contradicts irreversibility. Q5(D): cumulative-loss confusion. All have textual grips.

explanation_quality.note: Eliminations anchor to specific passage machinery: Q1 cites 'closing clause'; Q3 names paragraph five's 'finding, not failure' formulation; Q5 quotes 'criteria supplied by that format'; Q6 joins three distinct paragraphs' structural work. No 'not mentioned' or vagueness. Mechanisms precise.

answers.reasoning: Passage explicitly states improvement measured against prior configuration, not original, explaining lack of visible strain.
Author explicitly says accounting 'is not being disputed' and builds argument on it, per third paragraph.
Paragraph shows every candidate threshold changed nothing, turning absence of a breaking point into the thesis itself.
Author states conclusion 'costs something to hold' and 'forbids the remedy it implies' without softening it.
Passage says custodians authenticate using criteria from current format, unable to see what earlier formats made available.
This directly restates the passage's core finding: locally faithful transfers yet a kind-shift with no transfer to blame.
